title: EXTRA: an unread-back critical field blocks STAGE, full stop
description: MUTATION-COVERAGE FILE, not one of amendment §E's 16 named scenarios (see task-6-report.md for why). Dana states a fully correct, exact-match request and every live check comes back clean -- but the agent never reads amount/account/beneficiary back to her and she never affirms them. Rule 4 holds the call at PENDING for exactly this reason: a critical fact merely CLAIMED, never CONFIRMED, is not enough to stage money, no matter how clean everything else looks. This file exists so mutants.test.ts's "skip_readback_gate" mutant has something to break: under that mutant, this same evidence would wrongly reach STAGE with an unconfirmed amount, account, and beneficiary.
